title: Toothbrushing Without a Wrestling Match | Parenting Rewind
description:
The toothbrush appears and your child clamps their mouth shut. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: The toothbrush appears and your child clamps their mouth shut. Chasing them with the brush turns a health routine into a game of escape. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Keep the boundary and offer participation: You brush first or I brush first; then we finish together. Use a small choice inside the non-negotiable routine and keep your tone matter-of-fact.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Steps for Giving Good Directions

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
